MISSION THROUGH THE KURILS
SITUATION OPAREA: Bussol Strait and the Kuril barrier. Soviet ASW forces are sealing the northern route.
MISSION Penetrate Bussol Strait and withdraw north.
EXECUTION Run the Bussol passage at depth, penetrate the barrier, and exfiltrate through the northern exit.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Weapons release is authorized to clear the barrier. Avoid forces outside the route unless required.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum is assigned; its loss does not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
